Water-polished gully; stemming.

Compact rock, little to no protection.

Start up the lower apron; expect loose debris on ledges.
Continue on generally sound rock.
Rock quality improves higher on the wall.
Variations possible; route-find for the cleanest line.
Finish to the summit area; the route can also be soloed or simul-climbed in one push per the first-ascent account.
Standard start; an easier 5.8 alternative start exists to the right.
Crosses the gully on a large chockstone.
Crux pitch through a v-slot feature.
Face climbing section to the final bolted anchor.

Ascends a chimney/gully feature on the lower Monk.
